## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run secret-scan`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, real keys or personal data in the code, screenshots or logs
- [ ] Every new data claim cites a primary source
- [ ] Non-partisan: the same method applies to every party
- [ ] No database migration, or a maintainer approved it in the linked issue
- [ ] I agree my code is AGPL-3.0-only and my data/content is CC BY 4.0
